# Task 2 Golden Fixtures

These JSON files are behavior fixtures, not copied Python implementation. Every
fixture carries a provenance field with the read-only Python source and line
range used to extract the contract, plus the corresponding section of
`docs/browserlogin.md` where applicable.

The `TEST-ONLY` credentials and signing material in this directory are synthetic
and must never be used for production BrowserLogin, Convex, GitHub, or CloakBrowser
services.
